author: akira_mo9
quote: GTA 6 isn't even close to feeling finished. Bugs everywhere, unstableperformance, random glitches, and somehow the game is strugglingto maintain 30 FPS. After waiting this long, I expected a polishednext-gen experience, not an expensive beta **** then there's Rockstar making a giant open-world crime gamewhere apparently every possible interaction has to be approved by acommittee. They give you a massive sandbox and then randomlydecide what you're allowed and not allowed to do. Like bro, eithergive us a proper sandbox or stop calling it one The devs spent years perfecting NPC hair, reflections, puddles, andsomeone's individual nostrils just for the game to run at 28 FPS whilethe NPCs teleport across the street.
